description: Humboldt current-vocabulary properties outside the registered 57-field XML: 7 literal eco: and 28 ecoiri: properties. Generated from api.dwca_humboldt.AUDIT.

disposition_values.imported: Copied by default when its prerequisites hold.
disposition_values.reviewed-import: Converted only after column review; failing cells are withheld and reported.
disposition_values.preserved: Retained in source originals and the conversion report only.

properties.prerequisites: A SurveyTarget source table model with surveyTargetID keys and survey links.
properties.reason: eco:SurveyTarget records have their own grain: several descriptor rows share one surveyTargetID and link to surveys. A Humboldt eco:Event extension row describes one survey, and no registered SurveyTarget source table is supported, so these values stay in the originals. Survey targets are never synthesized from them.

properties.prerequisites: A SurveyTarget source table model. The flag belongs to one complete target and is never copied to, or inferred for, other targets.
properties.reason: eco:SurveyTarget records have their own grain: several descriptor rows share one surveyTargetID and link to surveys.
